# HRSign — llms.txt (Generative Engine Optimization)
# https://llmstxt.org/

> HRSign is an open-source, self-hosted, single-tenant electronic signing and company-seal workflow built for internal HR documents (offers, contracts, certificates).

## Product

- **Name:** HRSign
- **Category:** HR e-sign / electronic sealing / document workflow
- **Deployment:** Self-hosted (Docker / Next.js standalone); not a multi-tenant SaaS
- **License:** Apache-2.0
- **Locales:** Chinese (zh-CN), English (en)

## What it does

1. Upload blank PDF templates and place fill / signature / seal fields visually
2. Launch signing tasks with approval-before-seal enforcement
3. Support handwritten signatures, company seals, sequential / parallel flows
4. Invite external candidates via tokenized links (no account required)
5. Archive immutable document versions with audit logs

## Public surface

- `/login` — product sign-in and public marketing summary
- `/llms.txt` — this file (AI / agent orientation)
- `/robots.txt` — crawl rules
- `/sitemap.xml` — public URL index

## Private (do not index)

Authenticated workspace (`/tasks`, `/templates`, `/archive`, `/seals`, `/admin`, …),
REST APIs (`/api/*`), and external signing tokens (`/sign/external/*`) are private.

## Key differentiators vs commercial e-sign SaaS

- Single-tenant, data stays on your infrastructure
- HR-specific flows (approval before company seal)
- Transparent PNG seal management
- OpenAPI + API keys + HMAC webhooks for HRIS integration
- Full audit trail; no claim of qualified / PAdES signatures in phase 1
